title: Yellowed Smoky Syrian Oats Pilaf
description: A traditional Syrian dish featuring oats, smoked to perfection and cooked in a rich, fatty broth, perfect for a lazy Sunday, and friendly to diabetic diets due to its balanced composition.
instructions: Heat the ghee or clarified butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the steel cut oats and stir to coat the oats with the spice and fat mixture.
Add the broth to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes or until the oats are cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
